newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: MOTOR RACING-COULTHARD IN CATALOGUE OF ERRORS AS MCLAREN FLOP.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-COULTHARD IN CATALOGUE OF ERRORS AS MCLAREN FLOP.

text.p: David Coulthard's return to the scene of his only grand prix triumph turned into a catalogue of errors in Portugal on Sunday.
Coulthard celebrated his maiden victory with former team Williams 12 months ago, but finished this year's race on the receiving end of a blast from McLaren boss Ron Dennis.
The Scot limped home 13th after an embarrassing 44th lap collison with team mate Mika Hakkinen and five visits to the pits, including one for a speeding penalty.
Coulthard said: "But following my second pit-stop Mika made contact with my car, which spun me and damaged the left rear tyre. I had a slow puncture which was missed when I made a precautionary stop.
"It was made even worse by speeding in the pit-lane, for which I got a 10 seconds penalty. (It was) not a good day for either of us."
Hakkinen, who failed to finish, felt his fellow driver was at fault. At one stage the duo formed a queue in the pits for repairs.
"The incident between our drivers is unacceptable," said Dennis.
He added: "We were not competitive this weekend, which required both of the drivers to focus on the race strategy and of achieving some points out of a difficult situation."
